CRLR No.541 of 2022
Hon’ble Ravindra Maithani, J.
Mr. Neeraj Garg, Advocate for 
the revisionist.
Mr. Lalit Miglani, A.G.A. for 
the State. 
Instant revision is preferred 
against the order dated 29.07.2022, 
passed in Case No.31 of 2020, Smt. 
Nishtha and another vs. Sandeep 
Kumar, by the court of Principal 
Judge, Family Court, Dehradun.
Heard.
It is submitted that, in fact, 
the private respondent has misled
the courts and is avoiding payment 
of interim maintenance, which is 
due on him. Certain orders have 
been referred to.
Having considered, this Court 
is of the view that this matter 
requires deliberation. 
Admit.
Issue notice to the respondent 
no.2, returnable within four weeks. 
Steps to be taken within a week.
List this case along with CRLR 
No.745 of 2019 on 14.03.2023.
 (Ravindra Maithani, J.)
 23.11.2022
Sanjay
